body: - **Step 7a (architectural guidelines)**: G-Cfg-1 deviation — `config.ENV_MODE: Final = "MODE"` (python/larch/core/config.py:511) is the existing canonical definition for the `MODE` env-var name, previously consumed via `ctx.str_value(key=config.ENV_MODE, ...)` in `design_step5c.py`. This diff removes that call site and the new `_resolve_summary_mode` helper (python/larch/design/design_summary.py) re-hardcodes the literal `"MODE"` instead of importing `config.ENV_MODE`, leaving the constant unused repository-wide. Minor and mechanically fixable; not gating.
